reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 허리 긴 강아지에게는 길이가 살짝 짧은듯 싶어서 한 사이즈 크게 시킬걸 그랬나 싶기도 한데 흉통이 잘 맞아서 그냥 입히려구요. 그리고 택 떼고 나서 보니까 모자 부분에 펜 같은 거로 까맣게 한 줄 그어져 있는 채로 왔더라구요. 검수 좀 잘 해주세요.
reviews.content_en: For my long-backed dog, the length seems a bit short, so I'm wondering if I should have ordered a size up. But since the chest fit is just right, I'll go ahead and use it as is. Also, after I removed the tag, I noticed there was a black line drawn across the hat part like it was marked with a pen. Please be more careful with quality control.
